column1: # Leakage audit of golden.jsonl: each query against every text it cites, for expected and must_not ids alike:
# the id title, the "why" line, and the cited source (repo file lines where..where+6, the pinned crate manifest,
# the fh catalog row with its quote at the pinned revision, the rigor-atlas row). leaky = a shared run of >= 3 consecutive words
# holding >= 2 content words, or >= 50% of the query's content words in the cited text; else independent.
# written 2000-01-01 by validate.mjs --write-leakage from a local mirror (--mirror), an example checkout (--fh-repo) and a DB copy (--ra-db sha256=0000000000000000)
